vibe: Premium Dark Editorial Technology. Executive Advisory meets Modern AI Laboratory.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.2]

rules: NEVER use Inter for headings. Use Sora with aggressive negative tracking for a premium feel.
Large typography must use fluid scaling (clamp) or responsive text sizes.
Editorial contrast: Mix large Sora headings with tiny, widely-tracked overlines.
No pure black (#000000). Always use tinted obsidian (#0a0a0c).
Use cyan sparingly as an electric highlight for interactive elements and data viz.
No generic gradients. Rely on flat dark surfaces with 1px structural borders.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-white/10) to define grids and containers.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Minimal glassmorphism. Use solid deep charcoal backgrounds with sharp edges. If glass is needed (sticky nav), use bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and a bottom border.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle noise or film grain overlay across the entire site to remove 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace drop shadows with subtle inner borders or diffuse ambient glow behind active elements.

patterns.scroll: MANDATORY: Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. The site must feel premium and weighty.
patterns.hero_reveal: Line-by-line masked text reveal on load using Framer Motion.
patterns.hover: Cards should have subtle border color shifts and a slight lift (-translate-y-1) on hover.
patterns.parallax: Subtle mouse-tracking parallax on the hero monogram and background abstract nodes.

rules: Avoid bouncy animations. Use smooth, slow, and restrained easing functions (e.g., cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).

layouts.grid_system: Use bento grids (Tetris logic). Grid lines should often be visible. Spacing must be generous (p-8 to p-24).

hero.layout: Large kinetic text on the left, visual anchor (abstract monogram) on the right. Background features subtle digital environment (AI nodes/network).
hero.features: Line-by-line reveal, CTAs: 'Explore AURA' / 'Work With Me', Sticky nav transitions from transparent to solid.

credibility_strip.layout: Horizontal marquee or strict 4-column bento strip.
credibility_strip.content: 20+ Years in IT / 10+ Years Technology Leadership / 65+ Distributed Business Locations / Enterprise Cloud•Infrastructure•Security

six_dimensions.layout: Bento grid (Mode A: Asymmetrical). 6 interactive pillar cards.

philosophy.content: Statement: 'Technology is not the destination. Business transformation is.' Contrast pairs: AI without strategy → Complexity, etc.

from_the_field.layout: Editorial experience cards (Problem → Thinking → Approach → Outcome). Do not use generic 3-column grids. Stagger them vertically.
from_the_field.content: Enterprise Cloud Transformation, Infrastructure at Scale, Cybersecurity & Governance, Enterprise Applications, AI & Automation.

decision_framework.layout: Progressive scroll animation using Framer Motion useScroll.
decision_framework.content: 01 Understand, 02 Simplify, 03 Secure, 04 Automate, 05 Scale, 06 Measure.

perspective.layout: Premium technology publication. Featured article spans full width, editorial cards below, category filters sidebar.

work_with_me.layout: Strategic Technology Advisory areas. List or grid of services. CTA 'Start a Conversation'.

contact.layout: Minimal professional form. No aggressive sales.

rules: DO NOT use generic stock photos of people in suits. Use the provided abstract imagery as the visual anchor.
Images must be heavily treated (darkened) or placed under a bg-black/40 overlay so they do not overpower the typography.

components.forms: Use Shadcn customized for a 'Midnight Terminal' look. Deep charcoal inputs, 1px cyan focus rings.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid white or cyan. Secondary: Transparent with 1px border. Sharp edges or slight radii (2px-4px). No massive pill buttons for standard UI.
components.cards: Cardless or 1px border outline. Background should barely contrast with the page background (e.g., #121217 on #0a0a0c).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG 2.2 AA. Use text-white or text-zinc-300 on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state, ideally a 1px solid border of the primary cyan color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a site for AURA BY ABHIJIT. Verify all facts and do NOT fabricate stats.
Initialize standard Shadcn components but override their default styles in Tailwind to match the 'Midnight Terminal' dark aesthetic.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root level.
Create Framer Motion variants for line-by-line text reveals and scroll-triggered fade-ins.
Build the backend with FastAPI to handle the contact form submissions and serve the mock articles.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all interactive elements.
The Hero should use the 'hero_portrait_abstract' image overlaid on 'abstract_ai_network' to create the 'sophisticated abstract digital environment'.
Never use `transition: all`. Always specify the exact properties.
DO NOT use Inter for Headings. Use Sora.
